result.summary: The image shows a narrow residential street with row houses and sidewalks on both sides but lacks formal pedestrian crossing infrastructure. There are no visible crosswalks, stop signs, or traffic signals at the immediate intersection, and parked cars may obstruct sightlines.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: The intersection lacks marked crosswalks, providing no designated space for pedestrians to cross.

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: Parked vehicles along the curb near the intersection may block the view between drivers and pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the street near the corner

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install zebra-style crosswalk markings to clearly define pedestrian right-of-way.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces closest to the intersection to improve visibility for all road users.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane at corners to shorten crossing distance and improve visibility.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment is currently a construction zone with a new refuge island being installed in a residential area. While the infrastructure improvements will likely enhance safety, the current state presents significant obstructions and navigation challenges for pedestrians and cyclists.

hazards.name: Trip Hazards

interventions.description: Establish a clear, ADA-compliant temporary path for pedestrians to navigate around the construction zone safely.

result.summary: The intersection provides basic pedestrian infrastructure including sidewalks and a marked crosswalk on one leg. However, the wide roadway and presence of parked cars near the crossing points create potential visibility issues and may encourage higher vehicle speeds.

hazards.name: Wide Unmarked Roadway
hazards.description: The lack of interior lane markings on a relatively wide street can lead to higher vehicle speeds and unpredictable positioning.

interventions.description: Install curb extensions (bulb-outs) to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility by moving pedestrians into the driver's line of sight.
